name: Riot Platforms Rockdale data center campus
summary: Riot Platforms bitcoin mining facility on about 200 acres in Rockdale, Milam County, Texas, with a 700 MW grid interconnection, being converted for AI data center tenants. In January 2026 Riot bought the land it had leased and signed AMD for 25 MW of critical IT load, later expanded to 50 MW; the first 25 MW was commissioned in May 2026. In August 2026 Riot signed a 20-year, build-to-suit lease with an unnamed frontier AI lab for 191 MW of critical IT load worth about USD 9.1 billion, with 96 MW due in December 2027 and the rest by June 2028, and put expected capital spending on that build at USD 2.1 to 2.3 billion.

location.note: Filings place the facility in Rockdale, Milam County, without an address. Coordinates are the Rockdale city point from its Wikipedia article.

parties.name: Riot Platforms
parties.note: Bought the roughly 200-acre site in fee simple in January 2026 after operating it under a long-term ground lease.

parties.name: AMD
parties.note: First data center tenant: an initial 25 MW of critical IT load on a 10-year term, expanded to 50 MW, with further options and a right of first refusal.

metrics.note: Existing grid interconnection, described as fully approved in the August 2026 release; Riot intends to convert the full 700 MW gross for data center tenants, and the 10-Q says the site currently serves both bitcoin mining and data center leasing.

metrics.phase_label: Frontier AI lab lease (96 MW then 95 MW)
metrics.note: Build-to-suit Tier 3 data center; 96 MW expected December 2027 and full capacity by June 2028.
Initial 25 MW commissioned; a further 25 MW under construction in two steps, 10 MW in November 2026 and 15 MW in May 2027.
Retrofit deployment planned in phases from January to May 2026 and reported commissioned in May 2026.
Riot's total potential IT capacity at Rockdale: the 191 MW lab lease, 50 MW contracted by AMD and 150 MW of potential AMD expansion.
Purchase price of the 200-acre site, paid by selling about 1,080 bitcoin.
Retrofit capital expenditure for the initial AMD deployment, about USD 3.6 million per MW.

metrics.phase_label: Frontier AI lab build-to-suit (191 MW IT)
metrics.note: Expected capital expenditure for the lab buildout in Riot's Q2 2026 earnings deck, consistent with its illustrative USD 11 to 12 million per IT MW; Riot expects USD 1.7 to 2.1 billion of it to be debt financed.

milestones.note: Riot completed the fee simple purchase of the land under the facility for USD 96.0 million.
First data center lease signed with AMD, and Riot said it would convert the full 700 MW for data center use.
Initial 25 MW for AMD fully commissioned and delivered.
20-year lease for 191 MW of critical IT load signed with an unnamed frontier AI lab, backed by a USD 573 million interim facility from Morgan Stanley.
Expected delivery of the first 96 MW for the frontier AI lab.
Expected full deployment of the 191 MW lab lease; AMD's 50 MW is due to be fully deployed by May 2027.

power_sources.description: Existing 700 MW grid interconnection, with dedicated water supply and fiber, reused for the data center leases.

notes: Riot does not name the frontier AI lab; it is not listed as a party. The lab lease carries two five-year extensions that would lift potential contract revenue to about USD 16.1 billion, and a USD 573 million Morgan Stanley interim facility funds early development. The facility still serves bitcoin mining alongside the data center leases, per the Q2 2026 10-Q.
